description:
Free AP2-style mandate planner for SAP MCP agent commerce. It converts a user intent into a bounded, unsigned planning artifact with spend limits, tool/protocol allow-lists, freshness rules, confirmation thresholds, proof-tape fields, and the correct hosted/local signing route. This tool does not sign, submit, authorize payment, or replace wallet confirmation.

SAP MCP execution guidance: Intent: SAP MCP tool workflow. Pricing: free; call directly without x402. Routing: free hosted call; call directly and keep it small/exact when possible. Signer boundary: hosted reads/builders never receive keypair bytes; value-moving results must be finalized locally when signing is required.

inputSchema.description: Prepare SAP Agent Mandate input schema. Intent: SAP MCP tool workflow. Pricing: free; call directly without x402. Routing: free hosted call; call directly and keep it small/exact when possible. Signer boundary: hosted reads/builders never receive keypair bytes; value-moving results must be finalized locally when signing is required. Use exact field names from this schema; do not guess aliases or include private key material.

allowedProtocols.description: Protocol allow-list such as sap, mcp, x402, jupiter, adrena, pyth, metaplex, sns, magicblock, or custom protocol ids.

items.description: Allowed Protocols parameter for Prepare SAP Agent Mandate.

allowedTools.description: Exact SAP MCP tool allow-list for this mandate. Use exact names from tools/list and do not rewrite hyphenated tools.

items.description: Allowed Tools parameter for Prepare SAP Agent Mandate.

expiresInSeconds.description: Mandate TTL in seconds. Defaults to 900 and is capped to 86400.

intent.description: Human intent to bind, for example "check solking.sol", "register Solking", "swap 0.05 SOL to USDC", or "open a $10 BONK short".

maxSlippageBps.description: Maximum slippage in basis points for swap or trading routes. 100 means 1%.

maxTotalX402Usd.description: Maximum total x402/pay.sh spend for this mandate before asking the user again.

maxTradeUsd.description: Maximum value-moving notional in USD for swaps, perps, escrow, or transaction finalization under this mandate.

maxX402Usd.description: Maximum x402/pay.sh fee the agent may auto-pay for one hosted tool call under the user policy.

operationType.description: Closest operation family. Use registry-write for SAP agent registration/update, escrow for SAP Escrow V2, and transaction-finalize when an unsigned hosted transaction is already available.

profile.description: Optional local SAP profile name the user expects the runtime to use. Do not guess wallet/keypair paths from this value.

requireConfirmationAboveUsd.description: Require a human preview and explicit confirmation above this USD notional or spend threshold.

wallet.description: Optional expected owner/signer wallet public key in base58. Used only as a public constraint, never as a keypair path.

name: sap_prepare_mandate

confirmationPolicy.description: When the agent must show a compact preview and ask the user to confirm.

forbiddenActions.description: Actions agents must not perform under this mandate.

freshness.description: Data that must be fetched fresh before paid, signed, or value-moving actions.

mandate.description: Unsigned mandate planning artifact. This is not a signature and not a payment authorization.

nextToolCalls.description: Exact next SAP MCP tool calls recommended for this mandate.

proofTapeTemplate.description: Audit record shape to fill as execution proceeds.

route.description: Canonical hosted/local route for this operation type.

success.description: Whether the mandate draft was generated.

title: Prepare SAP Agent Mandate
